name: Shechaniah
bio: Shechaniah son of Jehiel, of the descendants of Elam, spoke up as Ezra wept before the temple over Israel's intermarriage with the surrounding peoples. He proposed that Israel make a covenant with God to send away the foreign wives and their children, urging Ezra to take charge of the matter and promising him support (Ezra 10:1-4). Ezra acted on his proposal, making the leaders swear an oath to carry it out.
